summary.headline: Lunar Year Knowledge Table
summary.text: Table on knowledge of the lunar year, recording crescents for Dhu al-Qi'dah, Dhu al-Hijjah, Muharram, and Safar alongside equatorial distances, northern latitudes, visibility, and astrological judgments. The accompanying account correlates Chinese, Khaqani, Hijri, Roman, and Yazdgerd eras, mentioning Nebuchadnezzar and the Turkish-Chinese year name Dhaquq.
